cases.question: What is the monthly premium for the Basic plan?
cases.expected_answer: The Basic plan costs £24 per month per insured adult.

cases.question: What is the annual deductible on the Standard plan?
cases.expected_answer: The Standard plan has an annual deductible of £750.

cases.question: How much is the annual deductible for the Basic plan?
cases.expected_answer: The Basic plan has an annual deductible of £1,500.

cases.question: What is the annual coverage ceiling on the Premium plan?
cases.expected_answer: The Premium plan pays a maximum of £1,000,000 per policy year.

cases.question: What does the Premium plan cost per month?
cases.expected_answer: The Premium plan costs £95 per month per insured adult.

cases.question: What excess applies to each claim on the Standard plan?
cases.expected_answer: An excess of £40 applies to each separate claim on the Standard plan, in addition to the annual deductible.

cases.question: Which ShieldCare plans include dental cover?
cases.expected_answer: Dental treatment is included on the Standard and Premium plans, and is not included on the Basic plan.

cases.question: How do the waiting periods compare across the three plans?
cases.expected_answer: The waiting period is 90 days on Basic, 30 days on Standard and 14 days on Premium.

cases.question: How many physiotherapy sessions per year does the Premium plan cover?
cases.expected_answer: The Premium plan covers 24 physiotherapy sessions per year, subject to GP referral.

cases.question: What out-of-network reimbursement rate applies to the Standard plan?
cases.expected_answer: Treatment outside the provider network is reimbursed at 60% of the eligible cost on the Standard plan.

cases.question: Which plan includes an annual health assessment?
cases.expected_answer: Only the Premium plan includes an annual health assessment.

cases.question: If I have treatment on the mid-tier policy, how long do I have to send in the paperwork?
cases.expected_answer: On the Standard plan, claims must be submitted within 60 days of the date of treatment.

cases.question: What is the monthly premium for the Platinum plan?
cases.expected_answer: The indexed documents do not describe a Platinum plan, so this cannot be answered from them.

cases.question: Does ShieldCare offer a discount for bundling pet insurance?
cases.expected_answer: The indexed documents say nothing about pet insurance or bundling discounts.

cases.question: Who is the chief medical officer of ShieldCare?
cases.expected_answer: The indexed documents do not name any ShieldCare personnel.
